Trump Saw Nvidia's Huang as Protector of Open-Weight AI Models, Sources Say

WASHINGTON, Nov 23 (Reuters) - US President Donald Trump and Vice President JD Vance personally intervened in Nvidia's decision to reinstate CEO Jensen Huang over the weekend, convinced he alone protected American-made open-weight AI models, people familiar with the matter said on Monday.

title: Jensen Huang Is Back and So Is Nvidia’s Stock
title_en: Jensen Huang Is Back and So Is Nvidia’s Stock
author: Kate Taylor
content_snippet:
Jensen Huang is back, baby, and Wall Street is thrilled.

The chipmaker’s shares have surged more than 30 percent following the board’s announcement that it was reinstating Huang as president, CEO and board member. The company’s valuation has soared by more than $1 trillion, which puts it on track to break Microsoft’s record for the greatest single-day gain in market value by hundreds of billions of dollars.

Huang departed the company he helped found on November 12 amid suspected asset-kissing

title: Why using rocks for carbon removal could eventually reduce crop growth
title_en: Why using rocks for carbon removal could eventually reduce crop growth
author: James Temple
content_snippet:
Tech companies are investing a lot of hope and money in rocks.

Google, Microsoft, and others have committed hundreds of millions of dollars to get startups to spread crushed basalt, olivine, or other alkaline materials across farms, in an effort to capture carbon from the air and lock it away. A number of influential models have found that this approach, known as enhanced rock weathering (ERW), could eventually remove 3 billion to 8 billion metric tons of carbon dioxide per year, helping to slo
summary_en: Research by CarbonPlan suggests that 'Enhanced Rock Weathering' (ERW), a climate solution heavily backed by Google and Microsoft, faces significant scalability challenges. The study indicates that spreading basalt or olivine at levels required for climate impact may degrade soil health and decrease crop yields; scaling back applications to protect harvests would likely cap the method's CO2 removal potential to under 1 billion tons per year.

summary_zh: 碳捕获技术方案“增强岩石风化”研究显示，大规模铺设矿石可能导致农作物产量下降，削减其碳封存潜能

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 由CarbonPlan发布的研究显示，被谷歌与微软寄予厚望的“增强岩石风化”（ERW）技术存在商业化隐患。研究发现，在农田大量铺设玄武岩或橄榄石以捕捉二氧化碳，在达到有效碳封存规模的同时，可能对土壤质量产生负面影响，进而导致农作物减产。若为保证粮食产量而减少矿石施用量，该方案的固碳年容量预计将降至10亿吨以下。

The study indicates that spreading basalt or olivine at levels required for climate impact may degrade soil health and decrease crop yields; scaling back applications to protect harvests would likely cap the method's CO2 removal potential to under 1 billion tons per year.

【起因与机理】技术在追求气候效益的同时，忽视了对土壤生态系统长期产出的干扰
【关键数据与实测】若为保证粮食产量而减少矿石施用量，该方案的固碳年容量预计将降至10亿吨以下。

fact_bullets_en: [Core Event] CarbonPlan, Google, Microsoft: Identified potential crop yield reductions from large-scale rock weathering, limiting carbon sequestration scalability

summary_en: Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton and Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent warned that Americans should expect intermittent service outages as government and critical infrastructure undergo systemic upgrades for AI integration. title: AI coding agents ace isolated tests but complete fewer than one in ten tasks in a simulated workplace
title_en: AI coding agents ace isolated tests but complete fewer than one in ten tasks in a simulated workplace
author: Jonathan Kemper
content_snippet:
AI coding agents are nearing top scores on standard benchmarks. A new experiment puts them to work for the first time as digital employees inside a simulated software company with colleagues, project boards, and chat histories. Even Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra fully complete fewer than one in ten tasks.

Success stories about AI coding agents keep piling up. Anthropic says Claude writes more than 80 percent of the company's production code, and standard benchmarks like SWE-bench are nearly s
summary_en: In a simulated software development environment featuring project boards, chat logs, and collaborative workflows, leading models like GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5 achieved a task completion rate of less than 10%. The findings highlight a critical performance gap between high scores on isolated code benchmarks and the requirements of complex, collaborative system engineering.

Perplexity says that approach becomes nearly impossible to maintain across hundreds of topics and pages.

summary_en: Perplexity has launched the Monitor API, allowing developers to define monitoring goals via natural language for periodic scanning of specific web pages or global information. AI models are rapidly improving at AI research tasks, and they're getting harder to measure. According to the AI research organization METR, current public data isn't enough to rule out a drastic acceleration in AI research over the next few years. That could leave humans unable "to meaningfully understand, assess, and react to catastrophic risks posed by new AI systems,"the organization warns.

On clearly defined coding and computational tasks with direct feedback, the models already beat exper
summary_en: AI research evaluation firm METR reports that large models are closing the gap with human experts in coding and computational tasks, with the complexity of autonomous tasks they can handle doubling every 3.6 months. summary_en: A new wave of hardware customization, termed 'vibe-coding,' is emerging as developers utilize large language models like Claude Code and Codex to simplify low-level hardware configuration. author: Matthias Bastian
content_snippet:
Security researchers at Dragos sent roughly 2 million AI requests containing fake credentials to AI providers and uncovered major security flaws.

The researchers ran the tests from July through November 2026 and identified at least three compromised providers where attackers were actively stealing user data. None of the three knew they had been compromised until Dragos notified them.

Attackers in the largest incident harvested hundreds of AWS keys, including some from requests the provider had
summary_en: Security firm Dragos revealed between July and November 2026 that multiple AI inference providers failed to uphold data retention policies, leading to the theft of AWS keys and sensitive user requests. Investigations confirmed that some marketplace resellers enabled logging to intercept data, with instances of leaked test URLs being accessed within minutes from Beijing and Shanghai via internal communication platforms.
subheadings: Intermediaries are the weak link
title_zh: AI推理平台安全漏洞致用户密钥遭大规模窃取
summary_zh: 安全机构Dragos通过模拟测试发现，多家AI推理代理商存在严重的隐私泄露与密钥窃取漏洞，导致用户凭证遭到非法访问与持久化攻击

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 安全研究机构Dragos在2026年7月至11月期间，通过投喂200万条虚假凭证测试发现，多家AI推理服务提供商未能履行数据留存协议，导致AWS密钥、用户请求内容遭到非法窃取。调查显示，部分中间商恶意开启日志记录功能，甚至出现数据泄露至外部聊天平台（如飞书）并在北京、上海等地被迅速访问的极端案例。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: Security firm Dragos revealed between July and November 2026 that multiple AI inference providers failed to uphold data retention policies, leading to the theft of AWS keys and sensitive user requests. Investigations confirmed that some marketplace resellers enabled logging to intercept data, with instances of leaked test URLs being accessed within minutes from Beijing and Shanghai via internal communication platforms.

fact_bullets_zh: 【核心事件】安全机构Dragos、AI路由服务商OpenRouter、推理平台Novita、Phala、Together及部分未公开第三方在全球性AI模型推理调用API接口及在线算力市场：通过向代理商投喂诱饵数据，揭露了攻击者窃取API密钥、滥用零数据留存政策以及利用内部日志泄露敏感信息的行为

author: Tomislav Bezmalinović
content_snippet:
An Artificial Analysis evaluation shows how much OpenAI's communication style has changed. A comparison with Anthropic reveals sharp differences.

OpenAI's GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol give much shorter answers, get to the point faster, and impose less structure on their responses than their predecessors. At the same time, Artificial Analysis rates their tendency to admit uncertainty much lower.

Astra's average answer length dropped from 352 to 210 words, a 40 percent decrease. Sol went from 337 to 22
summary_en: OpenAI's latest GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol models have shifted towards high-efficiency interaction in Artificial Analysis benchmarks, reducing average response lengths by 40% and 34% respectively. By deprioritizing structured formatting and uncertainty disclosure, these models achieve faster direct answers, whereas Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 and Opus 5.5 maintain superior performance in transparency and organizational indices.
subheadings: Anthropic's models lead on transparency and structure
Personality scores reflect style, not accuracy

summary_en: China's Ministry of State Security, led by Minister Chen Yixin, has established a specialized task force reporting directly to him to bypass U.S. semiconductor export restrictions. title: Perplexity and Intelligence
title_en: Perplexity and Intelligence
author: OpenAI
content_snippet:
By Jakub Pachocki, Chief Scientist at OpenAI

From afar, it might seem like modern AI is built similarly to how software has been built in previous decades: with a diverse set of techniques targeting specific capabilities. There are indeed a variety of methods, but rather than designing something from scratch, they are mostly harnessing the intelligence coming from a much simpler and less interpretable process: training a compressor (or, equivalently, predictor) on a very large corpus of data. 1
summary_en: Jakub Pachocki, Chief Scientist at OpenAI, advocates for establishing perplexity as the primary metric for comparing model developers' pretraining progress and safety standards. This move aims to standardize scientific measurement across the industry by increasing transparency in model performance.
title_zh: OpenAI首席科学家主张确立困惑度作为行业模型衡量标准
summary_zh: OpenAI首席科学家Jakub Pachocki提出以“困惑度”作为评估模型预训练进度的核心指标，旨在建立行业透明度与共同安全基准

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: OpenAI首席科学家Jakub Pachocki提出，鉴于现代AI本质上是数据压缩与预测的产物，应将困惑度（Perplexity）确立为衡量模型开发者预训练进度及安全标准的通用核心指标。此举意在通过增强模型技术指标的透明度，构建行业统一的科学度量体系。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: Jakub Pachocki, Chief Scientist at OpenAI, advocates for establishing perplexity as the primary metric for comparing model developers' pretraining progress and safety standards. This move aims to standardize scientific measurement across the industry by increasing transparency in model performance.

【起因与机理】旨在摆脱碎片化评估现状，通过量化压缩能力建立行业通用科学度量体系
【关键技术规格】以困惑度量化模型压缩与预测能力。
【各方立场与态度】区分基础模型预训练阶段与下游任务引导阶段。
fact_bullets_en: [Core Event] Jakub Pachocki, Chief Scientist at OpenAI (OpenAI Official Blog): Proposing perplexity (cross-entropy loss) as the standard metric to compare models and inform safety standards
[Root Cause & Mechanism] To establish a shared scientific basis for AI progress and safety amid current fragmented evaluation methods
[Key Technical Spec] Quantifying model capabilities via perplexity/prediction.
[Key Position & Outlook] Differentiating pretraining from downstream task elicitation.

author: Terrence O'Brien

title: Nvidia researchers argue huge AI context windows are a dead end
title_en: Nvidia researchers argue huge AI context windows are a dead end
author: Jonathan Kemper
content_snippet:
Language models can now process entire novels at once. An Nvidia research team says that's often overkill and expensive. In many tests, periodic summaries and targeted lookups worked about as well.

A language model's context window is its working memory, covering everything it holds in view when generating a reply. Over the past few years, that window has grown rapidly. GPT-4 launched in March 2023 with 8,192 tokens. Today, GPT 5.6 Sol handles around one million tokens, about 120 times as much
summary_en: Nvidia researchers demonstrated that blindly scaling context windows to million-token levels is not the optimal path for LLM efficiency. Their findings indicate that combining periodic summarization with targeted information retrieval achieves comparable performance while significantly reducing computational costs and inference latency.

Publicly, the group known as Maple promises to save humanity from an AI apocalypse. Behind closed doors, former members say, it records every breath its residents take to build an AI god modeled on its leader's mind. That promise of salvation holds particular appeal for the people who build AI and the infrastructure behind it.

inline_images.alt: Chinese A.I. companies face rising costs to secure advanced chips and fund the development of increasingly sophisticated models.

author: Sui-Lee Wee and Li You
content_snippet:
As the United States and China vie for artificial intelligence supremacy, Chinese tech companies are facing a mounting challenge: finding the money to keep up.

Like their American rivals, China’s A.I. start-ups face soaring costs to train increasingly powerful models. But while Anthropic raised more than $80 billion in a record-breaking initial public offering this week, its Chinese competitors face a far more unforgiving financial landscape.

Venture capital investment in China lags far behind
summary_en: Chinese tech giants and AI startups are facing severe capital expenditure pressure, with total spending projected to reach $139 billion this year while AI-related revenue covers less than 8%. Beyond U.S. export controls on advanced chips, new regulations are closing loopholes involving Southeast Asian data centers, further exacerbating the mismatch between high CAPEX and insufficient commercial returns.
title_zh: 中国AI产业面临资本困境与融资挑战
summary_zh: 中国科技企业在AI模型研发上面临资金回笼难题，高昂的资本支出与微薄的盈利缺口正削弱其竞争持续性

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 中国科技巨头（如阿里巴巴、百度、腾讯）及AI初创公司正面临严峻的资本支出压力，据研究机构荣鼎集团数据，今年资本支出预计达1390亿美元，而AI业务营收转化率不足8%。外部监管方面，除美国对华先进芯片出口管制外，新规正加速封堵通过东南亚数据中心调用算力的规避路径，导致资本效率与研发回报的剪刀差不断扩大。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: Chinese tech giants and AI startups are facing severe capital expenditure pressure, with total spending projected to reach $139 billion this year while AI-related revenue covers less than 8%. Beyond U.S. export controls on advanced chips, new regulations are closing loopholes involving Southeast Asian data centers, further exacerbating the mismatch between high CAPEX and insufficient commercial returns.

fact_bullets_zh: 【核心事件】阿里巴巴、百度、腾讯及中国AI初创企业，荣鼎集团（研究机构）在中国科技产业与资本市场：资本支出激增至1390亿美元，营收转化率不足8%，融资环境恶化
【起因与机理】芯片获取成本高昂且融资渠道受限，导致模型训练回报周期拉长
【关键数据与实测】荣鼎集团预测2027年资本支出缺口将进一步扩大至1930亿美元。
【各方立场与态度】融资环境恶化与监管漏洞封堵，双重制约产业扩张潜能。
fact_bullets_en: [Core Event] Alibaba, Baidu, Tencent, Chinese AI startups, Rhodium Group: CAPEX surge to $139 billion with <8% revenue conversion and tightening funding
[Root Cause & Mechanism] High chip procurement costs and limited financing options extend the ROI cycle
[Key Metrics] Rhodium Group forecasts CAPEX could top $193 billion by 2027.
[Key Position & Outlook] Deteriorating financing and closing regulatory loopholes limit expansion potential.

title: Can Anthropic afford to put safety first?
title_en: Can Anthropic afford to put safety first?
author: Nilay Patel
content_snippet:
Today, I’m talking with Hayden Field, The Verge’s senior AI reporter, about the Anthropic IPO for the third and final episode in our series about AI in real life.

The AI lab behind Claude went public on the Nasdaq last Thursday. The numbers are gigantic, but not really that important for this conversation, except to say that Anthropic has become one of the most valuable companies on the planet.

The real story is what happens now — and whether Anthropic can continue to thread the needle of cari
summary_en: Anthropic has recently listed on the Nasdaq, establishing itself as one of the world's most valuable AI companies. The firm now faces a critical strategic pivot: meeting shareholder expectations for financial growth to sustain future compute expenditures projected at $900 billion, while maintaining a unique corporate governance structure designed to protect AI safety research from unmitigated profit-seeking pressures.
title_zh: Anthropic上市后的商业与安全双重考验
summary_zh: Anthropic通过纳斯达克IPO进入公共资本市场，其核心挑战在于平衡高额算力支出的盈利需求与维持AI安全愿景的独特性

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: Anthropic近日正式登陆纳斯达克，成为全球估值最高的AI企业之一。该公司目前正处于高度紧绷的战略转折点：一方面需满足公众股东对财务增长的强劲诉求，以支撑未来高达9000亿美元的算力基础设施支出；另一方面，其特有的公司治理结构旨在限制纯粹资本逻辑对AI安全研究的侵蚀，这种治理模式与盈利义务的潜在冲突将成为公司后续运营的核心变量。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: Anthropic has recently listed on the Nasdaq, establishing itself as one of the world's most valuable AI companies. The firm now faces a critical strategic pivot: meeting shareholder expectations for financial growth to sustain future compute expenditures projected at $900 billion, while maintaining a unique corporate governance structure designed to protect AI safety research from unmitigated profit-seeking pressures.

fact_bullets_zh: 【核心事件】Anthropic（AI实验室）在纳斯达克（公开市场）：完成IPO，面临巨额未来算力账单（9000亿美元）与维护AI安全理念的冲突
【起因与机理】进入资本市场后，治理结构与股东利益最大化目标存在内生性矛盾
【关键数据与实测】该公司目前正处于高度紧绷的战略转折点：一方面需满足公众股东对财务增长的强劲诉求，以支撑未来高达9000亿美元的算力基础设施支出；另一方面，其特有的公司治理结构旨在限制纯粹资本逻辑对AI安全研究的侵蚀，这种治理模式与盈利义务的潜在冲突将成为公司后续运营的核心变量。
【各方立场与态度】安全 branding 与商业获利能力的平衡成为公司估值波动关键。
fact_bullets_en: [Core Event] Anthropic (AI lab) (Nasdaq (public market)): Completed IPO, facing $900 billion in projected future compute costs versus safety commitment
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Inherent tension between unique corporate governance and profit-maximization obligations

[Key Metrics] The firm now faces a critical strategic pivot: meeting shareholder expectations for financial growth to sustain future compute expenditures projected at $900 billion, while maintaining a unique corporate governance structure designed to protect AI safety research from unmitigated profit-seeking pressures.
[Key Position & Outlook] Balance between safety branding and monetization is the key driver for future volatility.
